combo_label: Breakfast × The Blacksmith's Forge × The Domesday Book

entries.clue: Crisp golden patty of shredded potato, a diner-counter classic
Flaky crescent of many-layered dough, French in name but Viennese in ancestry
Grub out woodland and bring the ground under the plough
Four roods to one, the measure the mowing ground was entered in
Coarse-toothed file drawn round a horse's foot to level it
Heading in red ink marking off each landholder's section
Join two metal parts with an alloy melted in between at red heat
Church-floor memorial rubbed onto paper; also the band that blows, not bangs
Bread crisped brown in a slotted machine, then spread while it is still warm
Stretch of hours from waking until the clock strikes twelve
